record.question: The practice of having many wives.
record.explanation: Answer D: Polygamy. Polygyny is the precise term for one man having multiple wives, but it is absent from the four printed choices. Polygamy includes that arrangement and is the closest offered alternative; polyandry means multiple husbands and bigamy two spouses. Reference: https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/9781118924396.wbiea1377 Independently reviewed worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
